content: Form Settings Overview Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078795 Important Note: These form settings are only available for Custom Forms . This option does not display for Default Forms. To reach the Form Settings, click Edit on the preferred custom form: In the Edit view, the Form Settings option is in the top right: This article covers each of these settings and how they function. Once Edit Form Settings is clicked, a module with three tabs displays: Submission Settings Controls what happens after a form is submitted, such as the redirect or the message shown to the user. Submission Settings Email Notifications Controls the email notifications sent when a form is submitted, including recipients and message content. Email Notifications Developer Settings Controls advanced options such as the database table the submission posts to and the form's system name. Developer Settings For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
